text:
You're not tired. You're programmed.

Every thought you repeat becomes a command to your subconscious.

Say "I'm weak" daily for a year, your brain believes it.

Say "I solve things" daily for a year, you start solving them.

Your subconscious runs whatever you feed it. No judgment.

Most men inherit code from their dad, TV, random losers.

You reprogram today.

One belief. Thirty days. Say it.

You're not trapped. You're running bad software.
caption:
Your mindset is shaped by the thoughts you repeat to yourself every day.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
